digest.component_or_area: MCP client credential provisioning and secret delivery
propositions: Per-client bearer PATs must be materialized on-box from SSM at deploy time into environment variables (MCP_CLIENT_PAT_*), never committed to the repository or synced via rsync
The mcp-static-tokens.json file references PAT values only via token_env environment variable names, never as plaintext tokens or raw values within the file itself

Client credential config templates (mcp-clients.local.example.json) are committed as placeholders but real credentials files (mcp-clients.local.json) are gitignored and rsync-excluded to prevent secret leakage
The StaticBearerVerifier loads its token set once at initialization; PAT rotation requires restarting or replacing the rebar-mcp process/container, not merely rewriting the tokens file
The mcp-static-tokens.json file must always be created even when credential slots are empty, and an empty tokens set causes the verifier to fail-closed at startup until at least one PAT is populated
Gitignore and rsync exclude patterns must prevent mcp-static-tokens.json and mcp-clients.local.json from being tracked or synced, ensuring value-only rotations never overwrite materialized artifacts
